Next.js 16 App Router, TypeScript strict, Supabase, TanStack Query v5, HeroUI v2, Tailwind CSS v4, Vitest. All user-facing strings must be in Czech.

Use skills proactively: `/new-entity` for new table/model/CRUD (Do not scaffold files manually; invoke this skill.); `/db-sync` after DB migration or schema/type mismatch; `/new-migration` for new table/column/function/view/RLS policy; `/generate-barrels` after adding/renaming/removing hook/component/type/enum, before committing; `/review-pr` for code/PR review. Follow these patterns strictly. Do not deviate without explicit user instruction.

Entity paths: `src/types/entities/{camelCase}/schema/{camelCase}Schema.ts` (auto-generated), `data/{camelCase}.ts`; `src/queries/{pluralCamel}/{constants.ts,queries.ts,mutations.ts,index.ts}`; `src/hooks/entities/{kebab-case}/data/useFetch{Entity}s.ts`, `state/use{Entity}.ts`; `src/lib/translations/{pluralCamel}.ts`. Query/mutation functions receive `ctx: QueryContext` first and use `ctx.supabase`. Never call the Supabase client directly inside query files.
